headline: Nurture a Wild Surge
title: Nurture and Wild Surge | Rare Aniimo Step by Step | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Want rare Aniimo like Umbral and Prismana? Use Nurture. First earn the Bronze Badge for an area. Open the map, deliver Lumin Amber, and pick the Nurture tab. A Bloom appears on the map. Go there, interact with the sprout and choose Attract Aniimo. That starts a timed Wild Surge inside a green dome. Catching Aniimo builds Prismatic Energy. Save your better Aniipods for rare spawns. What rare one do you want? Comment below!
description: How to Nurture a Bloom and start a Wild Surge in Aniimo: get the area's Bronze Badge, open Nurture from the map, go to the Bloom, choose Attract Aniimo and catch Aniimo to build Prismatic Energy for Umbral and Prismana chances.
